bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the public policy text workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration using scikit-learn, examined stability across repeated fits, and inspected policy excerpts supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
Ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided product review records and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied notebook procedures using NLTK to apply a documented topic dictionary to review samples, then checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied pandas merge procedures joining document identifiers to metadata, checked unmatched records, ran supplied Matplotlib group-comparison visualizations, and documented missing-data handling.
Under supervision, wrote Python functions for parsing provided product review records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration using scikit-learn, examined topic stability across repeated fits, and inspected reviews supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
